def transform(grid):
    """Overlay binary panels above and below the uniform divider; mark overlaps as 2."""
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("panels have different heights")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Compare panels separated by a uniform nonzero vertical divider.

    Emit 2 wherever both corresponding panel cells are nonzero; otherwise 0.
    """
    width = len(grid[0])
    divider = next(
        c for c in range(width)
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)
    )
    panel_width = divider
    if width - divider - 1 != panel_width:
        raise ValueError("panels have different widths")
    return [
        [2 if row[c] != 0 and row[divider + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
         for c in range(panel_width)]
        for row in grid
    ]
